decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program builds directly on the firm's mental health and medical expertise, so the firm can interpret early results and improve it.
The carpentry workshop builds on the firm's established production and therapy know-how, providing related knowledge to learn from early results.
Outpatient sociotherapy is close to the firm's mental health and social service expertise, enabling the firm to assimilate feedback and adapt.
Counseling for senior living is directly related to the firm's eldercare knowledge and R&D, so early results can be interpreted and used for improvement.
The retail shop extends the firm's sheltered workshop activities, building on existing production and disability-support knowledge, though its commercial aspect adds some uncertainty.
